keySentence: He happily traded his heavy gold for a horse.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: First he had gold. Then he had a horse. Now he has a cow. He happily traded his heavy gold for a horse.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans started his journey with a huge lump of gold. He happily traded his heavy gold for a horse on the road. When the horse threw him off, he traded it for a cow. Each time he traded, he found a new reason to smile. Most people would be upset losing their gold. But Hans always looked at the positive side of things.
